setup: Matched release: one ball above the gray tile, one above ordinary floor.
name: Normal control

oracle.name: Normal control
oracle.law: Gravity, inertia, friction, and collisions follow ordinary physics. The gray tile has no effect.
oracle.plain: The gray tile does not change how objects move.
oracle.plain_zh: 灰色地砖不会改变物体的运动。
oracle.condition: A ball is on the decorative gray tile.
oracle.effect: Nothing extra happens. The tile is an ordinary-physics control.
oracle.scope: Gravity, inertia, friction and collisions remain ordinary.

reference: Same geometry, masses and scripted actions; the altered program is disabled only in the ordinary-physics reference.
